design_notes.serialization: Do not run tools/validate.sh and tools/fixtures_self_test.sh at the same time, in this tree or in one scratch copy. AT8 (validator gate) runs validate.sh; AT10 is the fixtures self-test; S05's case 8 chains them strictly serially in scratch behind a /proc refusal. The ten ATs and five S-checks run one at a time, in the foreground, in the order given in evidence_convention. AT4 begins with a real 'git fetch --tags --quiet origin' (a network read of the remote; it mutates no refs) and is captured verbatim including it.
hazards: The root tree carries an untracked .nizam/ directory: S03 fails closed in such a tree, scratch_run copies it into the scratch copy, and C9 exempts it. It is never in scope. Run the S-checks and captures in the attempt worktree (clean) or move .nizam/ away.

AT4 performs a real 'git fetch --tags --quiet origin' — a network read of the remote, expected by the amended AT. A network failure is ENVIRONMENT (retry), not DEFECT, and does not consume an implementation attempt.

AT5's 'Resolved'-ordering trap: the open-debt bullet must name exactly the live Open-set ids before the first occurrence of the word 'Resolved', and no resolved-row id may appear before it. The pinned new bullet was verified with AT5's own slicing logic against the pinned DEBT.md before pinning; S05 case 4 proves the trap is load-bearing by restoring the stale bullet.

AT9's version-scoped disposition: the only ROADMAP edits are the two pinned bullets; the released-tag bullets and the 'Latest released tag: v1.4.0' disposition line are untouched, and the new text never contains 'Latest released tag: v1.4.0' or 'Release in preparation: v1.4.0'. S04 re-runs the closeout's body-scoped disposition regex on the pinned file (count stays exactly one).

run_state and the feature list are Orchestrator-owned and land AFTER the implementation commit: AT1's yaml-completeness (in scope for 102) and AT6's exemption of 102 must both hold at the implementation commit; Mode B and QA see the Orchestrator deltas (run_state, feature list) on the promoted tree and treat them as owned, the 108 precedent.

C9 path-resolution: no new text may cite a path that does not exist at the implementation commit. The DEBT Resolution cell and the manifest note therefore cite only .agent/contracts/102.json, .agent/evidence/102/ga-readiness.json, .agent/evidence/102/at5-open-debt-roll.txt, docs/planning/phase_014.yaml — never .agent/qa/102.json (which exists only after QA).
The frozen acceptance infrastructure is read-only; AT7's pins fail the phase if any of the seven files drifted. S05 case 6 proves the pin is load-bearing.

Evidence honesty is a hazard in both directions: the dossier must not inflate thin evidence (recorded_consumer_adoptions is insufficient_evidence, not met) and must not soften met facts (stable_release_history, no_open_critical_high_debt, benchmark_thresholds are met with anchored measurements).

design_notes.rollback: Revert the single implementation commit on the feature branch (or drop the cherry-pick before promotion). The Generator does not edit .agent/run_state.json; the Orchestrator's close-out commit is a separate, independently revertible unit.
